entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: A cephalid, Raffine's spymaster of the Obscura and former reporter, who questions everything and believes nothing without proof.

entities.name: Queza
entities.description: Kamiz's cephalid apprentice and the best Exactor in the Obscura, who believes in the angels and keeps a halo talisman.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: An ancient, powerful sphinx demon who leads the Obscura from the Cloud Spire and sees visions from the archdemons.

entities.name: Tivit
entities.description: A winged sphinx fortune-teller of the Obscura who is struck by the prophecy and whose shop is later wrecked.

entities.name: Oskar
entities.description: An Obscura agent who befriends rats and finds trash and halo signs.

entities.name: Lacey Lanine
entities.description: A leonin reporter for the Capenna Herald whose mind is wiped after she is used by a Broker.

entities.name: Denry Klin
entities.description: Lacey's editor at the Capenna Herald.

entities.name: Lagrella the Magpie
entities.description: A Broker lieutenant who collects contract breakers in her fish tank and manipulates Lacey to find Halo.

entities.name: Jinnie Myra
entities.description: A Cabaretti figure quoted in Lacey's Crescendo preview.

entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: A Cabaretti performer quoted in Lacey's Crescendo preview.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: The family of spymasters and seers under Raffine.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: The contract-wielding family that sells protection and tries to force Tivit to sign.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family said to have figured out how to make Halo.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A family that smashes Tivit's new stained glass.

entities.name: Echo Readers
entities.description: Obscura agents who read spectral afterimages.

entities.name: Angels
entities.description: Ancient beings who helped build New Capenna and left, whom some believe will return.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: Raffine's sanctum high in the clouds.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The district of the city where a warehouse imploded.

entities.name: Interfactorium
entities.description: The Obscura's map room.

entities.name: Nido Sanctuary
entities.description: The Brokers' headquarters above which a vault holds the Prophecy.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city where the visions spread.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magical substance that enhances spells and is thought to be creatable only by angels.

entities.name: The Prophecy
entities.description: A prophecy locked in a vault below Nido Sanctuary, foretelling that New Capenna will die when its Halo runs out.

entities.name: The vision
entities.description: A vision of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae and gold in the water, with halos everywhere, seen by seers across New Capenna but not by Raffine.

events.summary: Tivit is gripped by a prophecy of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae, gold in the water and halos, as Kamiz and Queza visit.
events.quote: "The kitten hiding the cream . . . Corvidae, flitting and pecking . . . Gold in the water . . . Hiding the cream, the kitten!"

events.summary: Seers across New Capenna report the same vision at the same time.
Raffine summons Kamiz to the Cloud Spire and tells her someone attacked the visionaries; Kamiz must find who sent the vision.
events.quote: "Someone attacked the visionaries of New Capenna. Unacceptable."

events.summary: Kamiz takes Queza's angel talisman, lecturing her to question everything and believe nothing without proof.
events.quote: "We are the Obscura spymasters, Queza. We question everything and believe nothing without proof.

events.summary: Kamiz and Queza trace a warehouse explosion in the Mezzio to a reporter, Lacey Lanine, and call Oskar.
events.quote: There. An explosion in the Mezzio.

events.summary: Denry Klin tells Kamiz and Queza that Lacey is probably out with Lagrella the Magpie.
events.quote: "One of those straightlaced Brokers. Lagrita or something."

events.summary: Echo Readers show a four-person spellcasting team, with Lacey bringing them Halo, before a spell devoured the warehouse.
events.quote: Something stuck, and it devoured the room.

events.summary: Lacey is found in a dumpster with her mind wiped.
events.quote: Found her sitting in a dumpster in a stupor. Mind wiped."

events.summary: Tivit's shop is set aflame and its balcony collapses; Kamiz rescues Tivit but Queza appears crushed before emerging unharmed.
events.quote: Kamiz projected her magic forward, gripping Tivit's thick fur and Queza's long coat

events.summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
events.quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

events.summary: Queza finds halos in the buildings where visions occurred and says it is a message from the angels; Kamiz scolds her and removes her from the case.
Kamiz tells Raffine the visions were not seen by Raffine herself, since the Cloud Spire has no halos.
events.quote: "Because you didn't see any vision at all."

events.summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
events.quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.

events.summary: Queza and Kamiz trap Lagrella with a mirror, forcing her to nullify Lacey's contract, which restores Lacey's memory.
events.quote: Lagrella's signature cracked the paper in two.

events.summary: Kamiz admits Queza was right and returns her talisman and sigils, saying maybe she does not know everything.
events.quote: "Ridiculous. But maybe . . . maybe I don't know everything."

relations.quote: while her apprentice stepped into the sun and gaped.
One of the perks of being Raffine's spymaster
The glass walls let the powerful sphinx demon overlook her city
Lagrella the Magpie was a Broker lieutenant.

relations.note: used and tried to silence her
relations.quote: I sent Lacey to get me a sample.
